dialogues.speaker: Ippolit
dialogues.text: Ah, that wind of freedom — it's calling to me...

dialogues.speaker: Ippolit
dialogues.text: I speak of freedom, my friend— glorious, glorious freedom! Tell me, have you read "The Legend of Vennessa"? It is a certified masterpiece around here!

dialogues.speaker: Ippolit
dialogues.text: I am so sick of life here in Zapolyarny! It is nothing but endless, mindless banquets... what a waste of my youth! I demand true freedom, the glorious freedom to do exactly as I please!

dialogues.speaker: Ippolit
dialogues.text: I want to become a bard, my friend. A truly great bard who sings epic songs of resistance and glorious freedom!

dialogues.speaker: Ippolit
dialogues.text: ...But what I simply do not get is, why would the character Vennessa have long hair? I mean, she is a warrior, so shouldn't she be sporting a fierce, short crop? At least, that is how I would write it!

dialogues.speaker: Ippolit
dialogues.text: May the Anemo... Hmm, what is it that they say? Ah, that's right! May the Anemo God protect you, unknown traveler!
